description:
Manage person files in people/. People are link targets for note.people and task assignees; they cannot be threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files; open only by default.
  show PERSON [--json] — show a single person file.
  new [--name NAME] [--category professional|personal|voluntary] — create a person file.
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file.

Flags:
  list: QUERY is an optional fuzzy search, ranking results by similarity; --all includes closed people; --json JSON output.
  show: PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md; --json JSON output.
  new: --name full name; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary.
  delete: PERSON is the full name; -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Igor Petrov", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts interactively on stdin for --name or --category if omitted. Always pass both.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is passed, and permanently removes the file.
  A person file must exist before `tasks set-assignee` will accept that name.
